audit_findings.title: Parent earnings are mixed with consolidated cash-flow adjustments
audit_findings.mechanism: Consolidated depreciation, working-capital and other cash-flow adjustments enter parent-level OE without allocation to the noncontrolling interests, while valuation is divided only among parent common shares.
audit_findings.evidence: Net earnings attributable to the noncontrolling interest, net of tax was $58 million and $61 million in the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The supplied audit identifies a demonstrated basis mismatch, and the filed $58m of 2025 NCI earnings confirms that the minority ownership is economically significant. The $58m is not itself the correction: the affected share of D&A, working capital and other adjustments has not been calculated. Because the error affects the recurring $709.8m OE anchor and every forecast year, it is reasonably capable of materially overstating value.
audit_findings.action: Rebuild 2025 OE entirely on a consolidated basis and deduct one consistently calculated NCI claim, or allocate every consolidated adjustment between parent and NCI. Reconcile that treatment to every component of the $310m stakes_net bridge and rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: Equity-method affiliates may be counted twice
audit_findings.magnitude: $310m bridge exposure; $35m of 2025 affiliate earnings, equivalent to about $492m of base-case operating PV if capitalized at the model's anchor-to-PV factor; exact overlap unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Affiliate earnings may be capitalized through anchor OE while the same unconsolidated affiliate interests are separately added through stakes_net.
audit_findings.evidence: Equity in affiliates’ earnings, net of tax was $35 million and $27 million in the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: Double counting is an unresolved possibility rather than a demonstrated error because the composition of stakes_net is missing. It is nevertheless material: the bridge addition is $1.48 per share if the entire $310m relates to those affiliates, while capitalizing the filed $35m of earnings produces about $492m of base operating PV under the model's own factor. Either exposure is large enough to affect the valuation range.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the security-by-security composition and valuation of stakes_net. For every separately added affiliate, remove its equity earnings and distributions from OE or remove the stake from the bridge, then rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: Pre-spin history may describe a different business perimeter
audit_findings.mechanism: PHINIA-inclusive historical OE could distort the trend estimate, volatility assessment and selected growth rates; a sufficiently lower constant-perimeter trend could replace the current $709.8m capped anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: The historical results of operations of PHINIA for periods prior to the Spin-Off are presented as discontinued operations in these Consolidated Financial Statements.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates that PHINIA is excluded as discontinued operations in the current financial statements, but the record does not show how the 2016–2021 OE observations were constructed. Thus a historical perimeter error is possible, not demonstrated. Its materiality cannot be established without rebuilt continuing-operations data, although it could affect both the too-hard assessment and growth contract.
audit_findings.action: Trace every historical OE input to a PHINIA-excluded continuing-operations calculation. Recompute the trend and reassess growth scenarios; rerun valuation if the corrected trend falls below $709.8m or changes the growth contract.

audit_findings.title: Recurring restructuring must not be normalized away
audit_findings.magnitude: $101m FY2025 and $39m H1 2026 restructuring expense; the FY2025 amount equals 14.2% of the $709.8m OE anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: Adding back recurring cash restructuring raises anchor OE, while associated savings may also enter projected growth and margins.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company continues to evaluate different options across its operations to reduce existing structural costs over the next few years.
audit_findings.explanation: Recurrence is demonstrated: restructuring was recorded in 2023–2025, another $39m was recorded in the first half of 2026, and further actions remain under evaluation. Whether the anchor actually removed these costs is unresolved because its detailed bridge is absent. If it did, the filed cost is large relative to OE and could materially overstate value, especially if forecast savings were retained.
audit_findings.action: Inspect the 2025 OE bridge for restructuring, accelerated depreciation, facility-exit costs and related tax effects. Retain normalized recurring cash costs or explicitly model remaining costs and resulting savings without double counting, then rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The full cash balance may not belong to or be distributable to parent common equity
audit_findings.magnitude: $2.448bn added to the bridge, equal to $11.68 per share and 19.2% of the $12.731bn base equity value; disallowed portion unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Cash and short-term investments are added directly to the equity bridge after portfolio interest income is removed from OE.
audit_findings.evidence: The majority of cash and cash equivalents held outside the United States is available for repatriation.
audit_findings.explanation: The full $2.448bn addition is demonstrated, but the inaccessible, minority-owned or operationally required portion is not quantified. The filing says only that a majority of foreign cash is available for repatriation and reports $1.4bn held outside the United States. Given that the full addition represents nearly one-fifth of base equity value, a reasonable restriction or operating-cash deduction could materially change the valuation.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile cash and STI by legal entity and ownership; identify operating liquidity, trapped balances, repatriation taxes and cash attributable to NCI. Add only parent-accessible excess cash and rerun the bridge and per-share values.

audit_findings.title: Unfunded retirement obligations may be an omitted senior claim
audit_findings.magnitude: $63m comprising $36m of net unfunded pensions and $27m of unfunded OPEB, about $0.30 per share and 0.5% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Any obligation not represented by sustainable pension funding in OE would require a deduction from the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: The funded status of all pension plans was a net unfunded position of $36 million and $66 million at December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: Omission is not demonstrated because operating cash flow already includes retirement contributions and the OE treatment is unavailable. Even assuming the full filed $63m requires an additional bridge deduction, it is only about 0.5% of the $12.731bn base equity value and $0.30 per share, too small by itself to change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Confirm whether OE reflects normalized pension and OPEB funding, including the plan termination. Deduct only the residual claim not already captured; no standalone scenario rerun is needed unless the reconciliation identifies obligations materially above $63m.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: approximately $40.0m in FY2017 and $40.1m in FY2018; $0 direct valuation impact under the current anchor cap
audit_findings.mechanism: Eligible residual D&A would increase historical OE and the historical trend, but the model anchors at the lower of trend and latest actual OE.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2017 $367.8m (90.2% of filed D&A); FY2018 $391.2m (90.7% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: The conservative exclusion is demonstrated, but eligibility of the residual is unresolved. It cannot overstate value. The current trend of $914m is already $204.2m above the $709.8m latest-actual cap, and adding eligible historical D&A would increase rather than reduce that trend. Therefore it does not change the anchor or current scenario values.
audit_findings.action: Classify the residual D&A from filed disclosures. Update historical OE for analytical completeness, but rerun valuation only if the classification changes the selected growth contract rather than merely raising the already-capped trend.
